text:
maria-eng: Quick check — vendor (BrightCloud) pushed an updated GPU catalog CSV and some SKU IDs don't line up with our Terraform module for dedicated GPU pools. We need to validate before tomorrow's canary. Anyone able to triage?

george-infra: I can take a look. Which SKUs are problematic? Can you paste the CSV or example rows?

maria-eng: Link: https://vendor.example.com/catalogs/brightcloud_2026-03-20.csv — looks like fields `sku_id`, `hw_gen`, `rdma` changed. Example: `BC-A100-80G-v2` vs our `a100-80gb-v2`.

sanjay-procure: @maria-eng we got a vendor notice overnight — they said they normalized naming across regions. I asked them for an official mapping but haven't heard back. I'll open a ticket and chase.

oncall-bot: ticket created: #INC-4921 GPU catalog mismatch — assigned to sanjay-procure

george-infra: Did a quick grep in infra repo; our TF modules expect `a100-80gb-v2`. If vendor strings changed, `terraform import` / plan will fail. Quick mitigation: add an alias map in the module to translate incoming vendor SKUs to our internal ids.

eva-qa: Heads up — the latency canary uses that SKU for load tests. If the reconciliation breaks, the canary job will error out. Making the module tolerant sounds better than chasing vendor names mid-canary.

maria-eng: Can someone sketch the minimal patch? I can open a PR and run a smoke once that's ready.

george-infra: Patch sketch below — minimal, safe fallback to existing id: 

```hcl
locals {
  sku_aliases = {
    "BC-A100-80G-v2" = "a100-80gb-v2"
  }
}

# usage: lookup = try(local.sku_aliases[var.sku_id], var.sku_id)
```

I'll push a draft PR and tag @eva-qa for the smoke run.

sanjay-procure: Vendor replied with a mapping CSV (attached to #INC-4921). I'll paste the mapping into the ticket and request a stable header in future feeds. For now, accept george's patch and we'll reconcile full mapping in the ticket.

maria-eng: :thumbsup: thanks. One more question — any quota implications? If our reconciliation uses aliases, could the cloud provider treat this as a different SKU and hit a separate quota bucket?

george-infra: Shouldn't affect provider quotas — this translation layer is only in our internal reconciliation before we call the cloud APIs. The caveat: if we change the TF resource names (vs aliasing), we'll need a state migration step (`terraform state mv`). I'll add migration notes to the PR just in case.

eva-qa: I'll run the canary in staging after the PR is merged. ETA ~2h after merge for a full smoke (latency + OOM checks).

maria-eng: Great. Sanjay — please paste vendor mapping into the ticket and link the PR once it's up. I'll merge if CI/unit tests pass.

oncall-bot: deployment scheduled: infra/pr/4321 -> staging (canary) at 2026-03-21T03:00Z
